title: Hiding inside Palantir's skyrocketing quarter is a foreboding signal | TechCrunch
summary: Revenue grew 96% from a year earlier, and 20% from the previous quarter, to $2.31 billion, beating analysts’ expectations of $2.18 billion. The clincher was that Palantir’s U.S. commercial revenue surpassed U.S. government revenue for the first time ever.
